title: lesson-cards draws its card and asks before a block lesson
description: When Claude is about to run something the team already learned the hard way, a card with the lesson appears under that command, and for the serious ones it asks you "Proceed anyway?" first. The card is built from $.ui.resolve(e) elements and wrapped beside the row. A block lesson asks through $.ui.ask; Cancel answers { deny }, so the call never runs and the model reads the lesson as the reason.
